title: jev-wilson listing v1
description: One seller's record as a pool publishes it. p_L and u_F are Wilson bounds on k delivered of n graded. cheat is a separate flag: it never changes p_L, u_F or the premium.

p_L.description: lower Wilson bound on the delivered rate k/n

u_F.description: upper Wilson bound on the failure rate (n-k)/n; the premium ratio. Carried because 1 - p_L can differ from it in the last bits of a double

cheat.description: the last grade had cheat_shaped P(yes) >= 0.5 (THRESHOLDS_v1.cheatShapedMin), or a cheat was proven; a flag, not a price input

grade_id.description: id of the grade behind the latest record change (for example a Jev decision id), or null
